subject: Capability Fabric v1
scope: A deterministic Capability Fabric core that reuses the existing Deterministic Organ Fabric kernel.
Three source-reviewed active recipes: pure JSON transform, SVG status badge, and Workshop Direction adapter.
Human browser workbench plus read-only machine API and explicit CLI materialization boundary.
Detached Nursery-ready candidate packages with tests emitted but never executed by the Fabric.

futureSeam: Mirror or a mature Code Fabric may later submit recipe proposals through the inactive proposal contract. Such proposals cannot become active shared recipes without source review and Mike's merge decision.
reviewGuidance: Review the implementation commit together with the verification and live-visual receipts. Passing checks do not canonize this module.
